newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa hits one-yr high, coffee edges up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa hits one-yr high, coffee edges up.

text.p: COCOA - Surges to 1-year high on the back of steep NY gains. Sept hits high of 1,169 stg, highest since June 1996. Sept 16 up at 1,166 at 0923 GMT.
COFFEE - Gaps slightly higher and retains most gains in quiet, early trade. Sept up $18 at $1,815.
SUGAR - Nearbys trend up. Aug widens premium against Oct. Aug up $1.80 at $323.00.
